rows: Equipment: GIS circuit breakers 220 kV model GSPK-200P1 Toshiba
Procedure: Opening and closing time measurement (P1-Y1)

sections_en.text: This document shows the P1 test steps for measuring the opening and closing times of the circuit breakers using the device
Time Meter Test Set Model ZSK-2, which must be carried out on the circuit breakers annually as indicated above by the code Y1

It was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud and tested by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Emad El-Din Mohamed Abdel Salam on 14 April 2005 at the New Assiut power station, with the approval of Eng. Abdel Nasser Maarouf Ahmed, General Manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Mohamed Hassan Gomaa, Head of the Station Sector. It was reviewed by the coordinator of the Maintenance Procedures Information System at the Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company, Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control.

rows: Issue a work order, with the occupational safety and health category card available for the site personnel
Fence the work area and place the appropriate warning signs
Wear occupational safety and health equipment such as helmets and safety shoes suitable for the work, as well as masks
Open the breaker for which the opening and closing times are to be measured, as well as open the two isolating switches of the breaker and connect the two earthing switches.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Occupational safety and health tools such as helmets, masks and safety shoes
TIME METER Test Set Model ZSK-2
Disconnect the circuit breaker (CB) for which the opening and closing times are to be measured.
Disconnect the two isolating switches (Disconnected Switch) before and after the breaker.
Connect the two earthing switches before and after the circuit breaker (CB).
Connect the circuit breaker (CB) only, without connecting the two Disconnected Switches.
Disconnect the connection joining each phase to earth on the earthing switch on the side away from the voltage (use two open-end wrenches Nos. 13 and 19).
Use the attached tables, which have been prepared from the drawings of the site panels for the 220 kV system and the terminal connections as shown in Figure No. (1).

sections_en.text: First: Measure the breaker opening time using trip coil No. (1) Trip Coil (1)

rows: Connect terminal No. (P) before the operating switch (ON/OFF) on the Switch box to the positive terminal of trip coil No. (1) of the breaker in the site cell GLC-5 at terminal T1: 105
Connect terminal No. K on the Switch box to the terminals of trip coil No. 1 of the breaker in the site cell at terminals T1: 107, 109, 111
Connect terminals Nos. (A, B) on the Switch box to terminals Nos. (A, B) on the Time meter
Make a short circuit between points (A) and (P) after the operating switch (ON/OFF) on the Switch box
Connect the outgoing terminal No. (COM) on the Switch box to terminal No. (N) on the Time meter.
Make a short circuit between points (N, E) on the Time meter.
Connect terminal No. (E) on the Time meter to the GIS earth
Connect the incoming terminals Nos. (R, S, T) on the Switch box to the terminals Nos. (4, 3, 2) on the Time meter (THE CHANNELS).
Connect the outgoing terminals Nos. (R, S, T) on the Switch box to the terminals Nos. (R, S, T) on the terminals of the earthing switch whose connections have been disconnected.
Set the Selector switch on Switch box No. (AUTO-HAND) to the AUTO position
Set the Selector switch on Switch box No. {(C-O)-(CO)} to the (C-O) position
Set the Selector switch on Switch box No. (Kn-Kp) to the OFF position
Set the Selector switch on Switch box No. (K-H) to the K position
Connect the power supply 110V to the TIME METER device.
Set the Selector switch on Switch box No. (ON-OFF) to the ON position
Press START on the Time meter upwards ON
Set Paper Supply on the Time meter upwards ON
Press START on the Time meter downwards OFF
Set Paper Supply on the Time meter downwards OFF
Set the Selector switch on Switch box No. (ON-OFF) to the OFF position
Calculate the opening time for coil No. (1) as shown in the attached test certificate form

sections_en.text: Second: Measure the breaker closing time using the closing coil (Closing Coil)

rows: Connect terminal No. (P) before the operating switch (ON-OFF) on the Switch Box to the positive terminal of the closing coil of the breaker in the site cell GLC-5 at terminal T1: 97
Connect terminal No. (H) on the Switch Box to the closing coil terminal of the breaker in the site cell: Point (2) on the switch no. 3-52-53 (o c switch of CB53 on the local panel)
Set the Selector switch on Switch box No. (K-H) to the H position
Set the Selector switch on Switch box No. (ON-OFF) to the ON position
Press START on the Time meter upwards ON
Set Paper Supply on the Time meter upwards ON
Set the Selector switch on Switch box No. (ON-OFF) to the OFF position
Press START on the Time meter downwards
Set Paper Supply on the Time meter downwards
Set the Selector switch on Switch Box No. (ON-OFF) to the OFF position
Calculate the closing time as shown in the attached test certificate form

sections_en.text: Third: Measure the breaker opening time using closing coil No. (2) Trip Coil 2 Coil

rows: Connect terminal No. (P) before the operating switch (ON-OFF) on the Switch Box to the Positive terminal of trip coil No. (2) of the breaker in the site cell GLC-5 at terminal T1: 97
Connect terminal No. (K) on the Switch box to the terminals of trip coil No. (2) of the breaker in the site cell at terminals T1: 99, 101, 103
Connect the power supply 110V to the TIME METER device.
Set the Selector switch on Switch Box No. (ON-OFF) to the ON position
Press START on the Time meter upwards ON
Set Paper Supply on the Time meter upwards ON
Press START on the Time meter downwards OFF
Set Paper Supply on the Time meter downwards OFF
Set the Selector switch on Switch Box No. (ON-OFF) to the OFF position
Calculate the opening time for coil No. (2) as shown in the attached test certificate form
Open the two earthing switches before and after the circuit breaker (CB)
Lift the test set lead terminals
Connect the connection joining each phase to earth on the earthing switch.

Introduction
